title: Kiritani Haruka — MORE MORE HOUSE Surprise〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Sewing Lounge

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I didn't realize they had so many penguin designs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, some have penguins facing forward and some have them facing to the side, while others are just their faces.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But there's no need to worry. You can make all of these using outline stitches.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Really?
Still, there's so many. I don't know which to choose.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's okay to take your time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This penguin that's facing forward has such an adorably round figure to it...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But this other one facing sideways looks so cute and fluffy too...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(And this one's on its stomach.
It must be sliding across the ice...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which do I choose? They're all so cute...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You must love penguins quite a lot, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, Haruka, your eyes are twinkling like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I-Is it that obvious...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But you're right.
I do love penguins a lot.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I find their round figures very comforting for some reason. And the way they waddle is just too cute, and they swim so gracefully too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You should see all the penguin merchandise she owns. She loves them just that much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Penguin merchandise? That's amazing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I totally know that feeling!
I like collecting merch from my favorite anime.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I want to buy any that I come across.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, penguin merch is one thing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I also have a habit of buying any Phenny merch that I come across, because he looks like a penguin too. You should see how much stuff I have at home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I see why you're having trouble choosing a design, when you love them so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I think anyone would have trouble choosing just one of their most favorite things.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah, but I have to make a choice...
Otherwise, I'll never start the actual embroidery.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They're all really cute...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But if I choose a really complicated design to start with, then I might not be able to achieve a satisfactory result.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to make them look as good as possible, so it might be best to start with a simple design and get used to embroidering them from there.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Which means... My adorably chubby friend here is probably the answer.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've made my choice, Shizuku. I'm going with this one.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. This penguin looks so huggably soft.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, I'll show you how to transfer this design to your fabric. First, we'll use a sheet of tracing paper...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (My penguin's really starting to come together.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I can't help but smile after seeing my progress...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I need to keep doing my best, so it turns out really cute...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haruka looks like she's having a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I definitely wasn't expecting to see Kiritani in this sort of light.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it is sorta hard to believe that an A-list idol like Haruka loves penguins this much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But getting excited about your favorite thing is perfectly understandable.
